subject: Request: Exec clearance for Clearwave onboarding credit
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Clearwave proposal — need exec clearance for onboarding credit

Marissa / Karthik,

Quick summary: Clearwave (prospective customer in radiology SaaS) is asking for a one-time onboarding credit to offset what they estimate will be a higher-than-normal integration cost during a 3-month high-velocity pilot. Their ask is a 40% credit applied to the first 90 days of billed usage (approx $60k gross value). In exchange they will sign a 24-month commitment at a $1.5M ARR run-rate if pilot KPIs are met.

Why it's time-sensitive: Clearwave wants a written commercial exception in the next two weeks to proceed with procurement and schedule their integration engineers. They indicated competing pilots with two other vendors.

Key facts I pulled together:
- Pilot term: 3 months (expected start: Jan 2027)
- Estimated onboarding workload: burst of 50M inference tokens the first month, then taper to 12M/mo
- Proposed commitment: 24 months ($1.5M ARR) with standard SLAs
- Ask: one-time 40% credit on first 90 days of usage, refundable climbback if churn within 6 months

Request: I need exec clearance (VP/CFO level) to propose either:
A) Approve the 40% onboarding credit as a one-time exception (manual sign-off required) OR
B) Approve a capped credit alternative — 25% credit + 3-month technical support uplift and a phased usage floor.

I've attached the current draft MSPA and my usage model. Can you weigh in on which option you prefer for escalation to finance? If we escalate, who should be looped for the final sign-off (Marcus/Markus or directly CFO)?

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments: pilot_usage_projections.xlsx (XLSX), clearwave_mspa_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearwave proposal — need exec clearance for onboarding credit

Sounds like a sale we want to win. A couple of quick asks before we go to execs:

1) Please add ARR payback calc (months to recover credit at expected net new ARR) — I want to see 12/18/24 month scenarios.
2) Add a churn guard: if they churn inside 6 months, credit clawback should apply.
3) Confirm the legal language on refundable climbback (I think procurement will push).

If those are in the memo, push to Markus (CFO) with a recommendation: I would favour option B (25% capped + support uplift) unless finance says the long-term ARR makes 40% acceptable.

-Marissa

On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 9:14 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary: Clearwave is asking for a one-time onboarding credit...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: MEMO: Decision request — Clearwave onboarding credit (deal CLW-2026-145)

Markus,

Per Marissa's note, forwarding a short decision memo and model for approval. Recommendation is option B: a capped 25% onboarding credit applied to the first 90 days, plus 3 months of technical support (no charge), and a 6-month clawback if the account terminates. Rationale below:

- Expected net-new ARR: $1.5M over 24 months; payback at 12 months under baseline usage assumptions.
- Upside: high likelihood of cross-sell into imaging analytics; Clearwave has a broad enterprise footprint with 120 hospitals.
- Risk: early usage spike could increase short-term token cost; we mitigate with a production ramp plan and prefix caching.

Financial impact (high level):
- Gross one-time credit (40% ask): ~$60k
- Proposed cap (25%): ~$37.5k
- Estimated 12-month NPV uplift vs no-deal: +$1.1M

Attachments: proposed_pricing_matrix.csv (CSV), pilot_usage_projections.xlsx

Decision requested: approve option B (25% cap + 3 months support + 6-month clawback). If you prefer option A, confirm acceptance of the larger one-time hit. We need a written exception on letterhead to satisfy Clearwave procurement by Oct 27.

Thanks for the quick review — happy to hop on a 15 if you'd like to talk through the assumptions.

—Aditya

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MEMO: Decision request — Clearwave onboarding credit (deal CLW-2026-145)

Aditya — thanks for the concise memo. Two quick points from finance:

1) We will accept option B (25% cap + 3 months support) provided Revenue Ops signs off on the ARR payback model and legal accepts the 6-month clawback language. Marcus, can you run the sensitivity on payback months and confirm 12-month recovery under the conservative case?
2) Add a hard dollar cap of $40k on the credit (to control outliers).

If the two checks are green, I approve the exception and will sign the commercial exception memo. Please update the MSPA appendix and route to me for signature.

-Markus

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Diane Miller <diane.miller@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MEMO: Decision request — Clearwave onboarding credit (deal CLW-2026-145)

Thanks Markus — noted.

Updates in this thread:
- Revenue Ops (Marcus Lin) completed sensitivity and confirms 12-month payback in the conservative scenario (spread attached).
- Legal confirmed they can draft a clawback appendix and set the hard cap to $40k.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I'll update the MSPA appendix to reflect: 25% onboarding credit capped at $40k, 3 months technical support, 6-month clawback clause.
2) Marcus: please confirm via reply when you upload the sensitivity sheet to the drive link below.
3) Markus: once legal updates are attached, please sign the commercial exception memo and I'll send a formal letter to Clearwave procurement. We aim to get this completed by Oct 22 so their SOW kickoff can stay on schedule.

Diane — looping you so procurement knows the structure we'll propose on letterhead. Expect a formal doc from us once Markus has signed.

Thanks all — pushing to finalize.

Aditya Rao
